column2: Team{{notetag|Final formal standings available on January 6. No league matches were played from late November through February. All scheduled league games during this time were canceled or postponed due to weather. Following that, Lusitania played two more games, one against Boston on March 5th and one against Swedish-Americans on March 12th to clinch the league championship. Goal totals for the Boston-Lucy Recs match are included but goal totals aren't known for the Lucy Recs-Swedish Americans match.}}
